class: A site's own menu taken for a step of the application
symptom: Waystar's Workday, 2 October: the apply page was read before it had drawn, as 'other', and the plan's next step was the header's 'Search for Jobs', which leaves the application.
site: Workday and any site with a header/navigation menu
root_cause: press_next refused the site's menu only after the application form had been seen (_seen_form); a page still arriving at the start of a run had no such guard.
why_tests_missed: The menu test (UKG) covered a page reached mid-application, after the form; none covered the first page of a run.
fix: A button in the site's header, navigation or footer is never pressed as a next step (apply buttons aside): before the form is seen the page is read again; after, the run goes back to the job's own page.
prevention: Rules about what may be pressed hold from the first page of a run, not from a later state.
